title: Touring Silver

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Axor Touring Silver is built for mile-crushing grand tours and cross-country adventures, shielding distance riders across varying weather and long highway transitions. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1276g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~83 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Axor touring helmet with drop-down sun visor and Bluetooth-ready pockets.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Standard touring fit with moderate cheek padding; may feel slightly loose for long-distance comfort without a chin bar pad insert.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Axor Touring Silver: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Axor Touring Silver: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Axor Touring Silver. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Axor's Touring lineup, the Touring Silver brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Axor Touring Silver represents Axor's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~83 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Touring helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Axor Touring Silver delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
